\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 243-246 — a first pass}

\label{lesson:HI-R251-first-pass-words-from-chapters-243-246}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a litre and a metre.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item unsuccessful, proud, simple, cunning, quarrelsome
  \item a thousand, a hundred thousand, ten million, several, both
  \item every, all, some, a dozen, a pair
  \item iron, silver, paper, plastic, cotton wool
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Unsuccessful? (\textbf{\hi{नाकाम}}, \emph{nākām}.) Proud? (\textbf{\hi{घमंडी}}, \emph{ghamaṇḍī}.) Simple? (\textbf{\hi{सीधासादा}}, \emph{sīdhāsādā}.) Cunning? (\textbf{\hi{चालाक}}, \emph{cālāk}.) Quarrelsome? (\textbf{\hi{झगड़ालू}}, \emph{jhagṛālū}.) A thousand? (\textbf{\hi{हज़ार}}, \emph{hazār}.) A hundred thousand? (\textbf{\hi{लाख}}, \emph{lākh}.) Ten million? (\textbf{\hi{करोड़}}, \emph{karoṛ}.) Several? (\textbf{\hi{कई}}, \emph{kaī}.) Both? (\textbf{\hi{दोनों}}, \emph{donõ}.) Every? (\textbf{\hi{हर}}, \emph{har}.) All? (\textbf{\hi{सब}}, \emph{sab}.) Some? (\textbf{\hi{कुछ}}, \emph{kuch}.) A dozen? (\textbf{\hi{दर्जन}}, \emph{darjan}.) A pair? (\textbf{\hi{जोड़ा}}, \emph{joṛā}.) Iron? (\textbf{\hi{लोहा}}, \emph{lohā}.) Silver? (\textbf{\hi{चाँदी}}, \emph{cā̃dī}.) Paper? (\textbf{\hi{काग़ज़}}, \emph{kāgaz}.) Plastic? (\textbf{\hi{प्लास्टिक}}, \emph{plāsṭik}.) Cotton wool? (\textbf{\hi{रुई}}, \emph{rūī}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 247-251 — a second pass}

\label{lesson:HI-R251-second-pass-words-from-chapters-247-251}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for silk and leather.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item silk, leather, so, if, or
  \item only, about, later, soon, suddenly
  \item with, all together, a computer, a mobile phone, a document
  \item a file, a safe, a stamp, a discount, retail
  \item wholesale, scales, a kilo, a litre, a metre
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Silk? (\textbf{\hi{रेशम}}, \emph{reśam}.) Leather? (\textbf{\hi{चमड़ा}}, \emph{cāmṛā}.) So? (\textbf{\hi{इसलिए}}, \emph{isliye}.) If? (\textbf{\hi{अगर}}, \emph{agar}.) Or? (\textbf{\hi{या}}, \emph{yā}.) Only? (\textbf{\hi{सिर्फ़}}, \emph{sirf}.) About? (\textbf{\hi{लगभग}}, \emph{lagbhag}.) Later? (\textbf{\hi{बाद} \hi{में}}, \emph{bād mẽ}.) Soon? (\textbf{\hi{जल्द} \hi{ही}}, \emph{jald hī}.) Suddenly? (\textbf{\hi{अचानक}}, \emph{acānak}.) With? (\textbf{\hi{साथ}}, \emph{sāth}.) All together? (\textbf{\hi{एक} \hi{साथ}}, \emph{ek sāth}.) A computer? (\textbf{\hi{कंप्यूटर}}, \emph{kampyūṭar}.) A mobile phone? (\textbf{\hi{मोबाइल}}, \emph{mobāil}.) A document? (\textbf{\hi{दस्तावेज़}}, \emph{dastāvez}.) A file? (\textbf{\hi{फ़ाइल}}, \emph{fāil}.) A safe? (\textbf{\hi{तिजोरी}}, \emph{tijorī}.) A stamp? (\textbf{\hi{मोहर}}, \emph{mohar}.) A discount? (\textbf{\hi{छूट}}, \emph{chūṭ}.) Retail? (\textbf{\hi{खुदरा}}, \emph{khuḍrā}.) Wholesale? (\textbf{\hi{थोक}}, \emph{thok}.) Scales? (\textbf{\hi{तराज़ू}}, \emph{tarāzū}.) A kilo? (\textbf{\hi{किलो}}, \emph{kilo}.) A litre? (\textbf{\hi{लीटर}}, \emph{līṭar}.) A metre? (\textbf{\hi{मीटर}}, \emph{mīṭar}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
